# Project Brain: the fault matrix

**Generated by `npm run julius:fault-matrix:export` from
`src/relay/mission/julius/julius-brain-fault-matrix.ts`. Do not edit by hand.**

Every row is one injected failure, with what must be true afterwards: how it may
be retried, what the Brain holds, what the attempt may claim, the decision the
service recorded, and what makes the history whole later.

11 of 27 rows are injected and asserted by
`julius-brain-fault-matrix.test.ts` itself ("automated"); the rest are injected
by the suites named in the table's source, several against a real PostgreSQL.

A future production deployment is expected to pass this same matrix. That is why
it is data rather than prose: the rows can be executed against whatever is
deployed, not only against local fakes.

| Case | Area | Phase | Injected failure | Retry | Mutation | Preservation | Audit | Recovery | Proof |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `auth.token-replayed` | AUTH | REGISTER | the same identity token is exchanged twice, including after a service restart | DO_NOT_RETRY | NONE | UNAFFECTED | SESSION_REFUSED:token_replayed | the runner requests a new identity token | automated |
| `auth.key-rotated-away` | AUTH | REGISTER | the issuer withdraws the key the token was signed with | DO_NOT_RETRY | NONE | UNAFFECTED | SESSION_REFUSED:token_key_unknown | a token signed by a published key | suite |
| `auth.issuer-unreachable` | AUTH | REGISTER | the issuer key set cannot be fetched and the cache is past its stale limit | SAFE_TO_RETRY | NONE | NOT_PRESERVED | SESSION_REFUSED:issuer_keys_unavailable | the run proceeds unpreserved (FRESH) or refuses (other modes); the archive recovers it | suite |
| `auth.mode-escalation` | AUTH | REGISTER | a registered attempt asks for a wider state mode, with or without a late grant | DO_NOT_RETRY | NONE | UNAFFECTED | SESSION_REFUSED:run_registration_mismatch | none: the attempt keeps the mode it registered | automated |
| `auth.session-expired` | AUTH | CALL | a call arrives after the session expired | SAFE_TO_RETRY | NONE | UNAFFECTED | CALL_REFUSED:session_expired | one renewal with a fresh identity token, same attempt and mode | automated |
| `service.unavailable` | SERVICE | OPEN | the Brain service does not answer at all | RECONCILE_BEFORE_RETRY | UNKNOWN_UNTIL_RECONCILED | NOT_PRESERVED | none | FRESH proceeds unpreserved; other modes refuse; the archive recovers the attempt | suite |
| `service.circuit-open` | SERVICE | SEAL | repeated infrastructure failure opens the breaker | SAFE_TO_RETRY | NONE | NOT_PRESERVED | none | the probe closes the breaker; preservation is read from the Brain, never assumed | suite |
| `service.rate-limited` | SERVICE | CALL | a run exceeds its own operation allowance | SAFE_TO_RETRY | NONE | UNAFFECTED | CALL_REFUSED:rate_limited | the same call once the window turns | automated |
| `service.request-replayed` | SERVICE | CALL | a client loses a response and repeats the request id | SAFE_TO_RETRY | ONCE | UNAFFECTED | CALL_ALLOWED: | the first answer is returned, marked replayed | automated |
| `network.lost-mid-commit` | NETWORK | MIRROR | the connection is lost while a commit is in flight | RECONCILE_BEFORE_RETRY | UNKNOWN_UNTIL_RECONCILED | AT_RISK | none | read the Brain, then retry under the same idempotency key | suite |
| `network.lost-after-commit` | NETWORK | SEAL | the commit lands and the response never arrives | RECONCILE_BEFORE_RETRY | ONCE | UNAFFECTED | none | the read settles it; the retry is a no-op | automated |
| `database.unavailable` | DATABASE | OPEN | the database refuses connections | SAFE_TO_RETRY | NONE | NOT_PRESERVED | none | FRESH proceeds unpreserved; other modes refuse; the archive recovers it | suite |
| `database.read-only` | DATABASE | MIRROR | the database is read-only (a failover, or maintenance) | SAFE_TO_RETRY | NONE | AT_RISK | none | retry when writes return; the seal reports what is missing; the archive recovers the rest | suite |
| `database.tls-untrusted` | DATABASE | OPEN | the database presents a certificate the service does not trust | DO_NOT_RETRY | NONE | NOT_PRESERVED | none | an operator fixes the configuration; nothing retries without verification | suite |
| `database.schema-mismatch` | DATABASE | OPEN | the database is migrated beyond, or behind, this code | DO_NOT_RETRY | NONE | NOT_PRESERVED | none | the migration step runs, or the code is rolled forward | automated |
| `transaction.timeout` | TRANSACTION | MIRROR | a lock or statement timeout cancels the commit | SAFE_TO_RETRY | NONE | AT_RISK | none | the retry commits once | suite |
| `transaction.killed-mid-commit` | TRANSACTION | RECOVER | the committing backend is terminated part-way through an import | RECONCILE_BEFORE_RETRY | NONE | AT_RISK | none | a cold retry imports exactly once, identical to a clean import | suite |
| `artifact.foreign-read` | ARTIFACT | CALL | a session asks for an artifact its state mode does not admit | DO_NOT_RETRY | NONE | UNAFFECTED | CALL_REFUSED:artifact_not_admitted | none: the artifact is not this run's to read | automated |
| `artifact.digest-mismatch` | ARTIFACT | RECOVER | supplied artifact bytes do not hash to the digest the export declares | DO_NOT_RETRY | NONE | UNAFFECTED | none | the exporter is fixed; nothing is stored beside a claim it does not match | suite |
| `checkpoint.refused` | CHECKPOINT | SEAL | the seal lands and the checkpoint does not | SAFE_TO_RETRY | NONE | PARTIALLY_PRESERVED | none | the attempt is PARTIALLY_PRESERVED; the archive recovers the rest | automated |
| `seal.missing-entries` | SEAL | SEAL | mirror failures leave v1 entries the Brain never held | DO_NOT_RETRY | ONCE | PARTIALLY_PRESERVED | none | the seal names the missing entries; the archive recovery reconciles them later | suite |
| `recovery.already-preserved` | RECOVERY | SEAL | an archive of an attempt the live run preserved is offered | DO_NOT_RETRY | NONE | UNAFFECTED | none | none is needed: the attempt is already whole | suite |
| `recovery.conflicting-history` | RECOVERY | SEAL | the archive disagrees with what the live run recorded | DO_NOT_RETRY | NONE | UNAFFECTED | none | a human investigates; nothing is merged | suite |
| `recovery.concurrent` | RECOVERY | SEAL | two recoveries of one attempt run at once | SAFE_TO_RETRY | ONCE | UNAFFECTED | none | one history, one RECOVERY trace; the other finds it imported | suite |
| `audit.unwritable` | AUDIT | CALL | the audit cannot be appended | SAFE_TO_RETRY | NONE | UNAFFECTED | none | the call is refused: an unaudited decision is not made | automated |
| `audit.rewritten` | AUDIT | CALL | the database owner rewrites the audit and rebuilds its chain | DO_NOT_RETRY | NONE | UNAFFECTED | none | the external anchors expose it; the Brain ledger is unaffected | suite |
| `audit.anchor-sink-down` | AUDIT | CALL | the external anchor sink is unavailable | SAFE_TO_RETRY | NONE | UNAFFECTED | none | the service keeps serving; only the verifiable window stops advancing, and that is alerted | automated |

## Reading the columns

- **Retry** — `SAFE_TO_RETRY`, `RECONCILE_BEFORE_RETRY` (the outcome is
  unknown; read the Brain first), `DO_NOT_RETRY`.
- **Mutation** — what the Brain holds afterwards: `NONE`, `ONCE`, or
  `UNKNOWN_UNTIL_RECONCILED`.
- **Preservation** — `UNAFFECTED`, `AT_RISK` (the seal will say), or the
  status the attempt ends with. Preservation is always read back from the Brain.
- **Audit** — the decision recorded, as `ACTION:reason`; `none` where the
  failure happens before any decision is made.
- **Recovery** — what makes the history whole afterwards, if anything.
